angles: Supply-demand crisis: Kimi K3's unprecedented demand overwhelmed Moonshot AI's GPU capacity within 48 hours — a rare case of a Chinese AI lab being too successful too fast
Open-source frontier: K3 is the first open 3T-class model, challenging the narrative that only closed models can achieve frontier performance
China AI race acceleration: Moonshot AI joins DeepSeek as a major Chinese AI player pushing the open-weight frontier, with 9 of past 12 months setting open-model size records
Pricing paradox: K3 is the most expensive Chinese AI model ever ($3/$15 per 1M tokens), yet still cheaper than proprietary alternatives for many tasks
Architecture innovation: KDA + Attention Residuals + Stable LatentMoE represent a novel architectural approach that could influence future model designs
Coding dominance: K3's top ranking on Frontend Code arena and strong kernel optimization performance signal a shift in which models lead in software engineering
Infrastructure bottleneck: The subscription pause highlights that even frontier AI labs face real physical constraints — GPUs remain the ultimate bottleneck
